purpose.zh: 练胸部，提升手臂向内合拢的力量
purpose.en: Build the chest and strengthen bringing the arm across.

text.zh: 肘微屈固定，手臂向身体前方合拢
text.en: Keep a soft, fixed elbow and sweep your arm in front of your body

text.zh: 弹力带固定在身后外侧、与胸同高
text.en: Anchor the band at chest height behind and outside your working shoulder.

text.zh: 慢慢放回，手臂不要拉到身体后方
text.en: Return slowly without letting the arm go behind your body.

commonErrors.zh: 肘关节弯伸，变成推的动作
commonErrors.en: Bending and straightening the elbow so it turns into a press.
Twisting the trunk with the arm.

cautions.zh: 用轻阻力弹力带，检查固定点牢固；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a light band and check the anchor is secure; stop if you feel pain.
